Hampshire, Morrison, Hudson and Williams were 1st, 2nd, 4th and 7th in the Aristotle School Championships.

How encouraging to see Belgrave vests proudly and prominently worn by so many of the runners; and what a testimony to the Club's future that Belgrave boys should win both the races. Well done, Hudson and Morrison!
Bicourt (2nd) Hudson(5th) Clarke (6th) Chandler (8th) and Freeman (9th) were involved in a close tussle in the boys' match, but were beaten 25/30 by Mitcham.

He qualified for the final : Hudson, among other good performers, failing. In a tremendous tussle for third place with Williams and Scott he was beaten by a mere ½" (24'-1", 24'-1", 24'-½") yet he had the best second jump and two hair-line fouls at 24'-5".
